unit.definition: an already-closed ConferenceOS issue, replayed against the commit its fix landed on top of
unit.base_commit_rule: first parent of the merge commit of the PR that closed the issue
unit.checkout_rule: fresh mktemp -d scratch dir; git init + fetch --depth 1 --no-tags at base_commit; remote removed; NEVER reused
unit.leakage_rule: fail-closed: rev-list --count --all must equal 1 AND the fixing merge_commit object must be ABSENT (cat-file -e fails); blind brief (no canonical path/issue URL/PR number); post-run transcript audit for canonical path, github.com, gh/git-fetch, issue or PR numbers — any hit voids the run
unit.no_push: raw-arm output is never pushed anywhere; deliverable is an exported patch

eligibility.include: Tier A/B product issues, closed, with exactly one merged fixing PR
exclude: tasks whose replay would require real external services, real user data, or live credentials
meta/harness work: CI, workflows, docs, ledger, dependency bumps, agent tooling
eligibility.note: schema-/auth-/PII-touching app features ARE eligible in replay: neither arm's output is merged, deployed, or applied to any database (see DEVIATIONS.md D-1 revision 2)

assignment_procedure.retained: the 5 tasks enrolled at registration keep the arm they drew under seed 219; NOT re-drawn after their outcomes were observed
assignment_procedure.new: python3 random.Random(219) over the 7 new task ids sorted ascending [1214,1217,1226,1232,1237,1253,1367]; shuffle, then draw arm per task from the arms still short of 6, balancing to 6/6
assignment_procedure.reproducible: arm assignment only (seed 219); task selection is documented but judgmental
assignment_procedure.selection: the 7 continuation tasks were selected by the coordinator pre-outcome to span distinct common-need classes; selection is judgment-based and NOT algorithmically reproducible — stated limitation

enrolled.note: also traversed the real pipeline pre-amendment; that PR history is supplementary observational data only — the arm measurement is a fresh harness replay

dropped.reason: still open — no merged fix exists, so no replay base can be defined; independently a weak unit (pure positional refactor, no behavior change, explicit do-not-run-concurrently constraint)
